retired.reason: Agents already handle streaming without the feed. In the November 2026 key-feature eval (Opus, Sonnet, Sol, Terra; 48 runs per arm), 90% of runs passed without the entry and 98% with it. The one gap: on the load-time task, 5 of 16 runs without the entry didn't make client scripts wait for streamed parts.

feature.name: Instance streaming and streaming-safe code
feature.summary: With Workspace.StreamingEnabled, clients load only the world near each player, so games join faster and run on low-memory phones. Client scripts must expect any Workspace instance to be missing at any time.
replaces: Turning StreamingEnabled off to fix missing parts
Raising StreamingTargetRadius to keep far areas loaded
Client-side GetChildren scans and raycasts over the whole map
feature.guidance: With execute_luau in Edit, set workspace.StreamingEnabled = true and PredictiveStreamingMode = Enabled. In LocalScripts, get Workspace instances with WaitForChild or nil-checked FindFirstChild. Set ModelStreamingMode = Atomic on models a client needs whole; use Persistent rarely. On the server, call RequestStreamAroundAsync before moving a player; set FrustumStreaming for scopes or fast vehicles.
